text: The Fed just named AI the number one risk to the money system.
Do you know what happens if the AI boom goes bust?
The New York Fed asked big banks and investment funds what scares them most.
Back in the spring? Only fifty.
Here's why. Companies borrowed over six hundred eighty billion dollars to build AI data centers.
In twenty twenty-three, it was just one hundred thirty billion.
Add the leases and promises... and it's over two trillion dollars.
And some of that money goes in circles.
Big tech helps fund smaller AI companies... who spend it right back on big tech.
If AI keeps making money, nothing breaks.
But if profits disappoint, stocks could drop... and banks are tied to almost a trillion dollars of it.
The Fed isn't saying it'll pop. It's saying everyone is watching.
